run_ssl_training: run self-supervised learning training on ImageNet using SimCLR, VicReg, Barlow Twins, or BYOL loss functions
run_linear_probe_evaluation: run linear probe evaluation on a pre-trained SSL model to measure representation quality
run_distributed_training_submitit: run distributed multi-node SSL training on a SLURM cluster using submitit job executor
create_ssl_model: create an SSL network with a ResNet or VGG backbone and configurable MLP projector head
create_ssl_loss: create a SimCLR, VicReg, Barlow Twins, or BYOL loss function for self-supervised contrastive learning
